items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Shirley Scott? INTERVIEWEE: No, no, this is a saxophone player.

ctx.x: What were some of the — did you play with rhythm and blues bands and swing bands?
Yeah but they were right there. They were right there. Well I was doing it with “Cleanhead” and then Scott. What was his name. The organ player that played.
